statements.select:
SELECT AA.CODE_ID,AA.CODE_NM,ISNULL(BB.TOTAL,0) AS TOTAL, #base_ym# AS BASE_YM FROM (SELECT CODE_ID,dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'SA_TYPE',CODE_ID) AS CODE_NM FROM T_CODE WHERE UP_CODE_ID = 'SA_TYPE') AA LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT A.SA_TYPE ,COUNT(A.SA_CD) AS TOTAL FROM T_SALES_ACTIVITY A, T_DEPARTMENT D WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND A.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD AND A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND A.DEPT_CD IN (SELECT DEPT_CD FROM T_DEPARTMENT WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND sadept_yn = 'Y' AND DEPT_LEVEL IN ('3','4','5'))
AND #base_ym# = SUBSTRING(A.SA_SDATE, 1, 6)
AND SUBSTRING(A.SA_SDATE, 1, 4) = SUBSTRING(#base_ym#, 1, 4) AND SUBSTRING(A.SA_SDATE, 1, 6) <= #base_ym#
AND A.DEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND D.UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup# AND A.DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
AND A.USER_CD = #user_cd#
GROUP BY A.SA_TYPE) BB ON AA.CODE_ID = BB.SA_TYPE

SELECT AA.CODE_ID ,ISNULL(BB.SATYPE_100,0) AS SATYPE_100 ,ISNULL(BB.SATYPE_200,0) AS SATYPE_200 ,ISNULL(BB.SATYPE_300,0) AS SATYPE_300 ,ISNULL(BB.SATYPE_400,0) AS SATYPE_400 FROM (SELECT CODE_ID FROM T_CODE WHERE UP_CODE_ID = 'MONTH' ) AA LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT SUBSTRING(A.SA_EDATE, 1, 6) AS BASEYM ,SUM(CASE WHEN SA_TYPE = 'SATYPE_100' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SATYPE_100 ,SUM(CASE WHEN SA_TYPE = 'SATYPE_200' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SATYPE_200 ,SUM(CASE WHEN SA_TYPE = 'SATYPE_200' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SATYPE_300 ,SUM(CASE WHEN SA_TYPE = 'SATYPE_400' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS SATYPE_400 FROM T_SALES_ACTIVITY A, T_DEPARTMENT D WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND A.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD AND A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND A.DEPT_CD IN (SELECT DEPT_CD FROM T_DEPARTMENT WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND sadept_yn = 'Y' AND DEPT_LEVEL IN ('3','4','5')) AND ISNULL(A.SA_SDATE,'') <> '' AND SUBSTRING(A.SA_SDATE, 1, 4) = SUBSTRING(#base_ym#, 1, 4)
AND A.DEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND D.UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup# AND A.DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
AND A.USER_CD = #user_cd#
GROUP BY SUBSTRING(A.SA_EDATE, 1, 6)) BB ON AA.CODE_ID = SUBSTRING(BB.BASEYM,5,2) ORDER BY AA.CODE_ID

SELECT AA.CODE_ID,AA.CODE_NM,ISNULL(BB.TOTAL,0) AS TOTAL, #base_ym# AS BASE_YM FROM (SELECT CODE_ID,dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'SA_TARGET',CODE_ID) AS CODE_NM FROM T_CODE WHERE UP_CODE_ID = 'SA_TARGET') AA LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT C.SA_TARGET ,COUNT(A.SA_CD) AS TOTAL FROM T_SALES_ACTIVITY A, T_SA_TARGET C, T_DEPARTMENT D WHERE A.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND A.SA_CD = C.SA_CD AND A.COMPANY_CD = C.COMPANY_CD AND A.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD AND A.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND A.DEPT_CD IN (SELECT DEPT_CD FROM T_DEPARTMENT WHERE COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND sadept_yn = 'Y' AND DEPT_LEVEL IN ('3','4','5'))
AND #base_ym# = SUBSTRING(A.SA_SDATE, 1, 6)
AND SUBSTRING(A.SA_SDATE, 1, 4) = SUBSTRING(#base_ym#, 1, 4) AND SUBSTRING(A.SA_SDATE, 1, 6) <= #base_ym#
AND A.DEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND D.UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup# AND A.DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
AND A.USER_CD = #user_cd#
GROUP BY C.SA_TARGET) BB ON AA.CODE_ID = BB.SA_TARGET ORDER BY AA.CODE_ID DESC
